issue.title: Define hijack custody for home-mode agents

task_type_fields.proposal:
Rows running in home mode (no numbered workspace) are refused by the v2 hijack decision with a home-mode refusal code, because hijack custody is defined as holding a numbered workspace claim plus the agent node and evidence.

Proposal: define what a home-mode hijack retains (e.g. a snapshot of the home-mode working directory and the agent node, with no workspace claim to pin) and let Continue/Escalate resume from that snapshot, so `,k` on a home-mode agent can stop it now without losing its work.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1t2 (plan:202611/agent_hijack_dependability.md) listed home-mode custody as a deferred follow-up for its land phase: the epic's custody model is the numbered workspace claim, and home mode has no claim to hold, so it needs its own retention design. Proposed by the plan's land phase sase-1t2.14 (not recorded there); filed by the sase-1t2 land agent.

issue.creation_reason: Deferred by epic sase-1t2's land phase and never recorded; the sase-1t2 land agent files it so home-mode hijack stays a tracked idea.
